articles.description: Shares up 7% after announcement as Jaime Gilinski Bacal seeks exit three years after helping to rescue bank Metro Bank is putting itself up for sale three years after its near-collapse, in a move that could hand a £420m windfall to its Colombian billionaire investor, Jaime Gilinski Bacal. Metro Bank made the rare decision to publicly announce it was open to bids on Thursday, paving the way for a wider pool of suitors. The announcement pushed the share price up by 7% by mid-morning, valuing the bank at around £1.3bn. Continue reading...

articles.title: Lucky Draw For Farmers At Kisan Tak Bharat Agriculture Conference 2026 At 9 PM
articles.description: India’s progress is closely connected to its farms, and farmers’ hard work and skill continue to shape the future of agriculture. In this India Today feature, discover a fun opportunity to celebrate that spirit: take part in a lucky draw and try your luck at winning a charming toy tractor. The campaign highlights the dedication behind farming while inviting viewers to join in and enjoy a little excitement. Whether you love agriculture, admire the people who grow our food, or simply enjoy a good giveaway, this video is for you. Watch to learn about the opportunity and see how you can participate. A toy tractor may be small, but it represents the hard work, ambition, and pride that drive farming communities across India. Share this video with friends and family who love farming, tractors, and exciting contests. Stay tuned to India Today for more stories, special campaigns, and engaging opportunities celebrating India’s farmers and the future of agriculture.
